name: Intake Log
query:
SELECT
	e.creation AS "When:Datetime:160",
	LEFT(e.method, 60) AS "Refusal:Data:260",
	JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.error, '$.call')) AS "Step:Data:200",
	JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.error, '$.ip')) AS "From IP:Data:130",
	JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.error, '$.sent.web_form')) AS "Form:Data:200",
	LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.error, '$.told')), 200) AS "Visitor Was Told:Data:420"
FROM `tabError Log` e FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE e.creation >= %(from_date)s AND e.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND e.method LIKE 'intake:%%'
ORDER BY e.creation DESC
LIMIT 500
